description: This file defines an interface for a factory that creates and manages Azure Blob Storage container clients in relation to Orleans Grain IDs, including initialization and retrieval of container clients.

classes.name: IBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating and initializing Azure Blob Storage container clients based on Grain IDs.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns a BlobContainerClient for the specified GrainId.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes dependencies with the provided BlobServiceClient and cancellation token.
